name: Crisp
description: Crisp is a customer-messaging platform for shared inboxes, website chat, support conversations, contact management, automation, campaigns, knowledge bases, and service operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned Crisp website identifier and website token keypair, then let selected agents use content-free conversation operations or approved documented website REST API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: CRISP_WEBSITE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Crisp website identifier
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the workspace website identifier paired with the website token.

credentialRequirements.name: CRISP_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER
credentialRequirements.label: Crisp website token identifier
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the identifier from a customer-generated single-workspace website token.

credentialRequirements.name: CRISP_TOKEN_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Crisp website token key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the secret key from the same website token keypair.

capabilities.label: Read conversation operations
capabilities.description: List bounded conversation operational metadata and read exact state without messages, previews, topics, people IDs, customer metadata, contact details, device/location data, compose contents, participants, mentions, segments, or attachments.

capabilities.label: Crisp REST API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented website-relative REST API v1 paths and methods allowed by the connected website token.

approvalRequired.label: List conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Crisp conversation operational summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read conversation state
approvalRequired.description: Read the state of one exact Crisp conversation without messages or customer metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Use REST API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Crisp website REST API v1 operation authorized by the connected website token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free conversation reads and every broader REST API operation require approval; fixed origin/version/website binding, secret isolation, provider token authorization, and bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected token-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/version/website binding, secret isolation, bounds, audits, provider authorization, and Crisp quotas still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted website token only to the fixed Crisp REST API v1 origin and configured website.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted website token only to the fixed Crisp REST API v1 origin and configured website.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Crisp website identifier and website token keypair are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A workspace owner generates a website token, enters its identifier/key and website identifier in Relay, and verifies bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader-operation behavior, token regeneration/revocation, quota behavior, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Crisp's official guide documents single-workspace website tokens, identifier/key Basic authentication, the X-Crisp-Tier website header, website identifier binding, and the 10,000-request daily quota.

Crisp's official REST API v1 reference documents the fixed api.crisp.chat origin, first-page conversation listing with 20-to-50 page size, exact conversation-state reads, website token tier support, and provider scopes.
